HOURS: Monday to Saturday, 10am to 7pm IST. Closed Sundays.

SETUP TIME: Most workflows go live within 48 hours of us getting access. Complex builds take 1-2 weeks.
WHAT WE DO: We build AI automations that connect the tools a business already uses — WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, Notion, CRMs. Lead response, customer replies, quotes, payment reminders.
CANCELLATION: Cancel any time, no exit fee. Workflows you have paid for keep running.
